releaseNotes:
Kerlyss 1.4.3-beta.1

New: In-App Update Survives App Close
- Windows: Downloaded update installs silently when you close the app. If killed, installs on next startup before UI appears.
- Android: If you close after download, Install bar reappears on next start â€” no re-download needed.
- Update progress bar now shows on every screen at bottom, never covers top-right buttons.

UI Fixes
- Playlist detail (Android): PLAY ALL / SHUFFLE + 4 tool icons wrap properly on narrow screens.
- Discovery tab: SEARCH SONGS / SPOTIFY IMPORT pills wrap on very narrow screens.

Internal
- Fixed import path depth in song_repository_impl.dart.

For Beta Testers
- Settings -> Check for Beta Updates
- Normal check only offers stable
- Beta builds opt-in, same signing key as stable
